capabilities: Highlight matching text while typing characters
Assign jump labels to matches for single-keypress jumps
Show the live search query in the status bar
Customize colors, label styling and label characters
Auto-toggle source mode when entering or leaving flash mode
extras: Development happens on GitHub; the author accepts donations.
problem: Jumping to a specific piece of visible text inside a note normally requires scrolling or repeated searching; this gives single-keypress jumps to any on-screen text.

relations.evidence: If you use Vim mode with the Vimrc plugin, add this to your .obsidian.vimrc

summary: Navigation plugin that highlights matching visible text as you type and assigns labels so you can jump anywhere in a note with one keypress.
